Plastic Cup Lid Size Chart: The Complete Guide to 90mm, 95mm, and 98mm Compatibility

Article Quick Facts

Calibers
90, 92, 95, 98, 107, 119 mm
PET Lid Types
Flat, dome, sipper and panda
PP Lid Types
Injection single-hole and double-hole
Matching Rule
Match the lid to the cup rim diameter

The Caliber System Explained

In the beverage packaging industry, "Caliber" refers to the outer rim diameter of the cup. To ensure a leak-proof seal, the lid diameter must match the cup caliber exactly. The most common international standards are 90mm, 95mm, and 98mm. Standardizing your shop around one or two calibers can drastically reduce your storage space and inventory costs.

Cup Caliber & Lid Matching Chart

Use this reference chart to find the right lid for your beverage type. All Claropack cups are engineered to these precise tolerances.

107 mm30oz, 32ozJumbo Flat/DomePET (Super-size)

Flat vs. Dome vs. Sipper Lids

Which lid should you choose? Flat lids are cost-effective for standard iced coffees and teas. Dome lids are essential for drinks topped with whipped cream or fruit. Sipper lids (strawless) are becoming the preferred choice in eco-conscious markets to reduce plastic straw usage. At Claropack, our PET lids feature a "Snap-Lock" rim design to prevent accidental pops and leaks during delivery.

Article FAQs

Can a 95mm lid fit a 98mm cup?

No. Even a 3mm difference will result in a loose fit and inevitable leaks. Always match the lid diameter exactly to the cup caliber.

Do you offer customized lids?

Yes. We can emboss your logo on PET lids or print custom designs on sealing films. Contact our team for the specific mold requirements.
